text:
The first phone built for agents just shipped.

Not an app upgrade — a new operating system where AI moves across your apps for you.

We're not behind. We're early.

Follow @layer8culture if you're building with AI.

Everyone's chasing the 'best' AI model. We stopped asking that question.

On Tech Thursday we ran the same brief across five different models back to back — video, image, and code — and watched each one fail somewhere different.

No single model does it all. That's not a flaw. That's the job: know which tool wins which round.

Builders who understand this stop wasting hours re-prompting the wrong model and start routing work to the right one on the first try.

This week, pick your own bench: one model for drafts, one for polish, one for code. Test it on one real task.

That's the actual AI fluency skill — not loyalty to a brand, judgment about the job.

Comment BUILD and I will send you the workflow map.
